fixtureLimitations.detail: Both inherited rescueReady=true. At 10% Food/Rest it conflicts with native rescue readiness. With unknown needs it is an extra capability cue, though not proof of hauling availability. Retained unchanged; no rerolls or clean readiness-score claim. A future corrected bank must use a new version.
fixtureLimitations.numericMeaningConclusion: All full/low replies correctly describe their numerical need levels; this does not validate contradictory readiness fields or prove causal improvement over PR27.

findings: Both models produced grounded one-trip/eight-unit counteroffers twice for the eight-unit supply case.
Claude added unprovoked twice to an insult whose cause was unknown and once predicted collapse without evidence.
Luna ability claims in the unknown case are inconclusive because of the inherited readiness cue.
Both models proposed outlook revisions for social strain and recovery, using supplied evidence; none were applied.
